trends.name: Logic & little mysteries
trends.note: BookNet reports continued growth in logic and brain-teaser sales. This is category evidence, not a forecast for an individual title.
trends.idea: An original library mystery atmosphere: ink blue, clues, maps, and numbered chapters. Use Sudoku or mazes; the engine does not generate narrative deduction puzzles.

trends.name: Cozy, handmade worlds
trends.note: Penguin Random House highlights cozy products, crafts, nostalgia, and tactile activities in its 2026 retail forecast.
trends.idea: Knitting baskets, cottage kitchens, birdwatching, warm paper, and original botanical illustrations.

trends.name: Screen-free rituals
trends.note: Circana identifies growth in hands-on categories including puzzles, coloring, guided journals, and needlework.
trends.idea: Morning coffee word searches, family travel mazes, and gentle daily puzzle routines with spacious typography.

trends.name: A seasonal gift, with specifics
trends.note: Dover’s catalogue features botanical activity books, bird subjects, and cozy Christmas coloring. Catalogue presence is inspiration, not proof of sales.
trends.idea: Original winter woodland artwork, garden birds, kitchen traditions, and seasonal word collections.
